newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria's police beefs up Sofia airport security.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria's police beefs up Sofia airport security.

text.p: Bulgaria's police on Tuesday said it would strengthen security precautions around the Sofia airport following recent bomb threats.
"Armed policemen will patrol in the passenger terminals and the border zone," an Interior Ministry official said.
There were two bomb threats only this month and as a result passenger terminals have been forcibly closed, he added.
He said police, the National Security Service and customs have implemented a package of measures for stricter controls on cargo movements through the country's border check points.
